   `_get_create_tables_sql(table_order, get_single_table_fn, ...)`
   into a shared module (e.g., benchbox/core/primitives_benchmark_utils.py

   into benchbox/core/tpc_audit.py or benchbox/core/tpc_patterns.py (which

   Add `_apply_cast(self, target_type: str)` private method to the relevant
   class in unified_frame.py, following the same pattern as the wave-2
   `_extract_date_part` helper. Each cast method (cast_float64, cast_int32,
   cast_int64) becomes: `return self._apply_cast("float64")`.

5. G17 -- TPC-DI loader parameterization:
   Extract `_load_data(data_type, path, validation_rules, ...)` base method
   in tpcdi/loader.py. Both load_dimension_data and load_fact_data become

   private method in datafusion_df.py, following the same pattern as the
   wave-2 `_polars_window_rank` helper. Each window function becomes:
   `return self._datafusion_window_rank("rank", order_by, partition_by)`.

   Extract `format_text_table(headers, rows, ...)` into
   benchbox/cli/commands/text_utils.py or benchbox/cli/formatting.py.

   Extract `list_benchmark_queries(module_path, query_prefix)` into
   a shared registry utility (e.g., benchbox/core/dataframe/registry_utils.py).
   All 4 benchmark registries delegate to this shared function.
description:
Wave-3 duplicate-check triage (2026-03-12, post wave-2) identifies 9
consolidation-worthy groups in the core library layer, CLI commands, and
DataFrame platform adapters. These are parallel implementations that can
be centralized into shared helpers or parameterized methods.

Targets (report rank -> dup lines):

G4  (49 dup lines): _table_exists in transaction_primitives/benchmark.py:342
    and write_primitives/benchmark.py:399. 2 copies with identical logic:
    query information_schema.tables -> check row count -> return bool.
    Same function in two primitives benchmark modules.

G10 (48 dup lines): get_create_tables_sql in transaction_primitives/benchmark.py:741
    and write_primitives/benchmark.py:898. 2 copies with identical pattern:
    iterate table_order -> call per-table SQL builder -> collect and join.
    Related to G4 - both are in the same two primitives benchmark files.

G13 (46 dup lines): _rank_by_geometric_mean and _rank_by_total_time in
    analysis/ranking.py:168 and :215. 2 methods in the same file with
    identical ranking algorithm structure, differing only by the metric
    computation (geometric mean vs sum of times).

G14 (46 dup lines): generate_audit_trail in tpcds/official_benchmark.py:252
    and tpch/official_benchmark.py:215. 2 copies with identical audit trail
    generation logic for TPC official benchmark compliance reports. Only
    the benchmark name and metadata fields differ.

G15 (46 dup lines): cast_float64, cast_int32, cast_int64 in
    unified_frame.py:1164, :1212, :1236. 3 methods with identical
    multi-platform dispatch (PySpark -> DataFusion -> Polars), differing
    only by the target type. Same pattern as the temporal extraction
    methods already consolidated in wave-2.

G17 (45 dup lines): load_dimension_data and load_fact_data in
    tpcdi/loader.py:48 and :94. 2 methods in the same file with identical
    data loading pattern (resolve path -> read files -> validate -> load),
    differing only by data type classification and validation rules.

G25 (44 dup lines): window_dense_rank, window_rank, window_row_number in
    datafusion_df.py:752, :775, :798. 3 methods with identical DataFusion
    window function dispatch, differing only by the rank method parameter
    (rank/dense_rank/row_number). Same pattern as the Polars window
    functions consolidated in wave-2.

G29 (42 dup lines): _format_text_output in cli/commands/calculate_qphh.py:90
    and cli/commands/metrics.py:232. 2 copies with identical text table
    formatting logic for CLI output.

G30 (42 dup lines): list_clickbench_queries, list_nyctaxi_queries,
    list_ssb_queries, list_tpcds_queries across 4 benchmark dataframe
    query registries: clickbench/dataframe_queries/registry.py:27,
    nyctaxi/dataframe_queries/registry.py:27,
    ssb/dataframe_queries/registry.py:31,
    tpcds/dataframe_queries/registry.py:33. 4 copies with identical
    registry listing pattern.

anti_patterns.why: callers across 20+ platform adapters and benchmark modules depend on the current signatures; changing them silently breaks the contract without a test failure

anti_patterns.dont: combine the ranking refactor with ranking algorithm changes
anti_patterns.instead: only extract the shared scaffolding, keep metric computation untouched
anti_patterns.why: the ranking algorithms are validated against TPC official QphH formulas; mixing structural refactoring with logic changes makes regressions harder to isolate

anti_patterns.dont: create abstract base classes for the registries
anti_patterns.why: 4 registries with a 14-line shared pattern doesn't justify the cognitive overhead of an ABC; contributors adding a new benchmark would need to understand the class hierarchy instead of copying a simple function call

anti_patterns.dont: merge transaction_primitives and write_primitives benchmark modules
anti_patterns.instead: only share the specific _table_exists and get_create_tables_sql helper functions
anti_patterns.why: they represent distinct TPC benchmark categories with independent evolution paths; a merge couples unrelated feature work

anti_patterns.instead: pass string literals like 'float64', not Python type objects
anti_patterns.why: explicit type strings preserve IDE navigability and static analysis across the 3 cast methods

preserves.behavior: Audit trail output format and content identical for TPC-DS and TPC-H
CLI text output formatting identical in both commands
Cast methods return identical UnifiedExpr types across all platforms
DataFusion window functions produce identical rank semantics
Ranking algorithms produce identical rank orderings and scores
Registry query listings return identical dictionaries
TPC-DI loader produces identical loaded data for dimension and fact tables
_table_exists returns identical bool for all table existence checks

uv run -- python -m pytest tests/ -v -k 'dataframe or unified_frame or datafusion'
uv run -- python -m pytest tests/ -v -k 'qphh or metrics'
